overview: Metro Chemicals is a premium pharma chemicals company website with a complete admin panel for managing products, purchases, sales, and inventory. Features a modern glassmorphism design, AI chatbot, dark mode, English/Hindi language support, and 9 interactive homepage sections.
features: 9 interactive homepage sections (Hero, About, Products, Manufacturing, Certification, Export, Global Presence, Testimonials, Contact)
Secure admin panel with product management, purchase records, sales tracking, and inventory management
Product image uploads via object storage
AI chatbot tailored for pharma chemicals purchase/sale
Dark mode toggle with localStorage persistence
Animated loading screen and scroll-triggered animations
3D card hover effects and glassmorphism design
